integrity: All stated ranks and determinant identities are replayed by exact symbolic arithmetic. No numerical approximation is used in the certificate.
limitations: The complete global singular locus is not computed.
The ordinary-double-point classification is proved generically along the collinearity locus for the explicit six-world-point configuration.
An equivalent formulation may exist in older projective-camera degeneracy literature under different terminology.
title: A Morse-Bott nodal collinearity stratum in six-point camera resectioning
